regime.headline: AI/large-cap leadership is holding up even as US yields stay elevated and HY spreads widen selectively.
regime.answer: US 10Y at 5.13% with ACM 10Y term premium ~0.73% (evidence present) while HY OAS widened sharply over 20 sessions; large‑cap breadth and megacap leadership remain intact and SMH has lagged QQQ but not collapsed, implying rates pressure is real yet broad market stress is not confirmed.
regime.implication: Higher nominal yields and front-end funding pressure are dominating market conditions, but equity breadth and megacap/AI strength blunt evidence of a broad risk‑off; watch whether HY widening and credit/volatility confirm a broader deterioration.
regime.whatWouldChangeMind: Sustained IG OAS widening, a persistent MOVE/VIX spike, or a material collapse in large‑cap breadth (all supported by canonical time‑series) would shift this assessment.

candidateExplanations: Narrow AI/semiconductor leadership is offsetting broad duration pressure at index level.
Company-specific catalysts and funded/backlogged AI infrastructure demand are overpowering the discount-rate headwind in selected names.
Positioning or short-covering may be amplifying resilience, but the current PS/Live contract does not yet verify that directly.
evidenceFor: Earnings (Meta) and issuer announcements can keep AI leadership bid even as yields rise; internal breadth within AI is mixed.
Broad market participation remains supportive of equity risk appetite even as rates tighten, limiting confirmation of systemic risk.
Nasdaq daily move -0.02 with bias UNRESOLVED.
evidenceAgainst: Nominal yields are high while modelled term premium softened; supply/auction context and funding remain the next tests.
portfolioDivergences.leadingHypothesis: Narrow leadership is masking the rate headwind rather than proving that duration sensitivity has disappeared.
portfolioDivergences.invalidation: If breadth broadens materially while credit remains benign and real yields stay high, the rate headwind is less dominant than assumed. If AI/semiconductor leadership rolls over, the divergence resolves in the bearish direction.
